items.source: Explicit encryption uses the MongoDB driver’s encryption library (org.mongodb:mongodb-crypt) to perform encryption and decryption tasks. The @ExplicitEncrypted annotation is a combination of the @Encrypted annotation used for JSON Schema creation and a Property Converter. In other words, @ExplicitEncrypted uses existing building blocks to combine them for simplified explicit encryption support.
items.translation: 显式加密使用 MongoDB 驱动程序的加密库（org.mongodb:mongodb-crypt）来执行加密和解密任务。 @ExplicitEncrypted 注解是用于 JSON Schema 创建 的 @Encrypted 注解与一个 属性转换器 的组合。 换句话说，@ExplicitEncrypted 利用现有的构建模块将它们组合在一起，以简化显式加密支持。

items.source: Client-Side Field Level Encryption allows you to choose between a deterministic and a randomized algorithm. Depending on the chosen algorithm, different operations may be supported. To pick a certain algorithm use @ExplicitEncrypted(algorithm), see EncryptionAlgorithms for algorithm constants. Please read the Encryption Types manual for more information on algorithms and their usage.
items.translation: 客户端字段级加密允许您在确定性算法和随机化算法之间进行选择。根据所选算法，支持的操作可能有所不同。 要选择特定算法，请使用 @ExplicitEncrypted(algorithm)，有关算法常量的信息请参见 EncryptionAlgorithms。 请阅读加密类型手册以获取有关算法及其用法的更多信息。

items.source: To perform the actual encryption we require a Data Encryption Key (DEK). Please refer to the MongoDB Documentation for more information on how to set up key management and create a Data Encryption Key. The DEK can be referenced directly via its id or a defined alternative name. The @EncryptedField annotation only allows referencing a DEK via an alternative name. It is possible to provide an EncryptionKeyResolver, which will be discussed later, to any DEK.
items.translation: 执行实际加密需要数据加密密钥（DEK）。有关如何设置密钥管理并创建数据加密密钥的更多信息，请参阅MongoDB 文档。 DEK 可以通过其 id 或定义的 替代名称 直接引用。 @EncryptedField 注解仅允许通过替代名称引用 DEK。 可以为任何 DEK 提供 EncryptionKeyResolver（稍后将讨论）。

items.source: By default, the @ExplicitEncrypted(value=…) attribute references a MongoEncryptionConverter. It is possible to change the default implementation and exchange it with any PropertyValueConverter implementation by providing the according type reference. To learn more about custom PropertyValueConverters and the required configuration, please refer to the Property Converters - Mapping specific fields section.
items.translation: 默认情况下，@ExplicitEncrypted(value=…) 属性引用的是 MongoEncryptionConverter。您可以通过提供相应的类型引用来更改默认实现，并将其替换为任何 PropertyValueConverter 实现。有关自定义 PropertyValueConverters 及其所需配置的更多信息，请参阅属性转换器 - 映射特定字段部分。

items.source: The Queryable annotation allows to define allowed query types for encrypted fields. @RangeEncrypted is a combination of @Encrypted and @Queryable for fields allowing range queries. It is possible to create custom annotations out of the provided ones.
items.translation:
`Queryable` 注解允许为加密字段定义允许的查询类型。  
`@RangeEncrypted` 是 `@Encrypted` 和 `@Queryable` 的组合，适用于支持范围查询的字段。  
可以基于提供的注解创建自定义注解。

items.source:
Choosing QE enables you to run different types of queries, like range or equality, against encrypted fields.
Please make sure to consult the MongoDB QE Documentation before you continue reading to learn more about QE features and limitations.
items.translation:
选择查询加密（QE）可让您对加密字段执行不同类型的查询，例如范围或相等性查询。
请继续阅读前务必查阅MongoDB 查询加密文档，以了解更多关于 QE 的功能和限制。

items.source: To use a MongoJsonSchema, you must supply it together with AutoEncryptionSettings which can be done e.g., via a MongoClientSettingsBuilderCustomizer.
items.translation: 要使用 MongoJsonSchema，必须将其与 AutoEncryptionSettings 一起提供，这可以通过 MongoClientSettingsBuilderCustomizer 来实现。

items.source: Additional options for eg. min and max need to match the actual field type. Make sure to use $numberLong etc. to ensure target types when parsing bson String.
items.translation: 例如，`min` 和 `max` 等附加选项必须与实际的字段类型相匹配。在解析 BSON 字符串时，请确保使用 `$numberLong` 等方法来保证目标类型。

items.source: There is no official support for using Explicit Queryable Encryption. The audacious user may combine @Encrypted and @Queryable with @ValueConverter(MongoEncryptionConverter.class) at their own risk.
items.translation: 目前官方并不支持使用显式可查询加密。 大胆的用户可以自行承担风险，将 `@Encrypted` 和 `@Queryable` 与 `@ValueConverter(MongoEncryptionConverter.class)` 组合使用。

items.source: A MongoEncryptionConverter instance configured with ClientEncryption and a EncryptionKeyResolver.
items.translation: 一个配置了 ClientEncryption 和 EncryptionKeyResolver 的 MongoEncryptionConverter 实例。

items.source:
Choosing CSFLE gives you full flexibility and allows you to use different keys for a single field, eg. in a one key per tenant scenario.
Please make sure to consult the MongoDB CSFLE Documentation before you continue reading.
items.translation:
选择 CSFLE 可为您提供完全的灵活性，并允许您为单个字段使用不同的密钥，例如在“每租户一个密钥”的场景中。
请继续阅读前务必查阅 MongoDB CSFLE 文档。

items.source: MongoDB supports Client-Side Field Level Encryption out of the box using the MongoDB driver with its Automatic Encryption feature. Automatic Encryption requires a JSON Schema that allows to perform encrypted read and write operations without the need to provide an explicit en-/decryption step.
items.translation: MongoDB 原生支持通过 MongoDB 驱动程序及其自动加密功能实现客户端字段级加密。 自动加密需要提供一个JSON Schema，以便无需显式执行加密/解密步骤即可进行加密的读写操作。

items.source: MongoOperations#createCollection(…​) can be used to do the initial setup for collections utilizing QE. The configuration for QE via Spring Data uses the same building blocks (a JSON Schema creation) as CSFLE, converting the schema/properties into the configuration format required by MongoDB.
items.translation: MongoOperations#createCollection(…​) 可用于利用 QE 对集合进行初始设置。通过 Spring Data 配置的 QE 使用了与 CSFLE 相同的构建模块（即JSON Schema 创建），将模式/属性转换为 MongoDB 所需的配置格式。

items.source: It is not possible to query a range indexed field with an equality operator.
items.translation: 无法使用equality操作符查询range索引字段。

items.source: It is not possible to query an equality indexed field with a range operator.
items.translation: 无法使用范围运算符查询已建立等值索引的字段。

items.source: Queryable Encryption will an extra field safeContent to each of your documents. Unless explicitly excluded the field will be loaded into memory when retrieving results.
items.translation: 可查询加密会在您的每个文档中添加一个额外字段 `safeContent`。 除非显式排除，否则在检索结果时该字段会被加载到内存中。

items.source: A PropertyValueConverterFactory that uses the registered MongoEncryptionConverter bean.
items.translation: 一个使用已注册的 MongoEncryptionConverter 豆的 PropertyValueConverterFactory。

items.source: The EncryptionKeyResolver uses an EncryptionContext providing access to the property allowing for dynamic DEK resolution.
items.translation: EncryptionKeyResolver 使用一个 EncryptionContext，该上下文提供了访问属性的途径，从而支持动态的 DEK 解析。

items.source: Client Side Encryption is a feature that encrypts data in your application before it is sent to MongoDB. We recommend you get familiar with the concepts, ideally from the MongoDB Documentation to learn more about its capabilities and restrictions before you continue applying Encryption through Spring Data.
items.translation: 客户端加密是一项功能，可在数据发送至 MongoDB 之前对其在您的应用程序中进行加密。 我们建议您先熟悉相关概念，理想情况下通过MongoDB 文档了解其能力和限制，然后再继续通过 Spring Data 应用加密功能。

items.source: Make sure to set the drivers com.mongodb.AutoEncryptionSettings to use client-side encryption. MongoDB does not support encryption for all field types. Specific data types require deterministic encryption to preserve equality comparison functionality.
items.translation:
请确保将驱动程序设置 `com.mongodb.AutoEncryptionSettings` 以启用客户端加密。
MongoDB 不支持所有字段类型的加密。
某些数据类型需要确定性加密，以保持相等性比较功能。

items.source: Please refer to the JSON Schema section for more information on defining a JSON Schema that holds encryption information.
items.translation: 有关定义包含加密信息的 JSON Schema 的更多信息，请参阅JSON Schema部分。

items.source: MongoDB supports Queryable Encryption out of the box using the MongoDB driver with its Automatic Encryption feature. Automatic Encryption requires a JSON Schema that allows to perform encrypted read and write operations without the need to provide an explicit en-/decryption step.
items.translation: MongoDB 支持通过其自动加密功能，利用 MongoDB 驱动程序原生提供可查询加密。 自动加密需要一个JSON Schema，该模式允许执行加密的读写操作，而无需显式提供加密/解密步骤。

items.source: Explicit encryption uses the MongoDB driver’s encryption library (org.mongodb:mongodb-crypt) to perform encryption and decryption tasks based on the meta information provided by annotation within the domain model.
items.translation: 显式加密使用 MongoDB 驱动程序的加密库（org.mongodb:mongodb-crypt），根据领域模型中注解提供的元信息执行加密和解密任务。

Queryable Encryption requires upfront declaration of certain aspects allowed within an actual query against an encrypted field.
The information covers the algorithm in use as well as allowed query types along with their attributes and must be provided when creating the collection.
items.translation: 可查询加密要求在针对加密字段执行实际查询之前，预先声明允许使用的某些方面。这些信息涵盖所使用的算法、允许的查询类型及其属性，并在创建集合时必须提供。

items.source: You can configure Queryable Encryption either manually or in a derived way:
items.translation: 您可以手动或通过派生方式配置可查询加密：

items.source:
Manual setup gives you full control over how encrypted fields are declared and how collections are created.
It’s useful when you need to explicitly manage data keys, encryption algorithms, and field mappings.
items.translation:
手动配置可让您完全控制加密字段的声明方式以及集合的创建方法。  
当您需要显式管理数据密钥、加密算法和字段映射时，它非常有用。

items.source: ✅ Full control over encryption configuration
items.translation: ✅ 完全掌控加密配置

items.source: ✅ Explicitly manage data keys and algorithms
items.translation: ✅ 显式管理数据密钥和算法

items.source: ✅ Allows for complex encryption scenarios
items.translation: ✅ 支持复杂的加密场景

items.source: ✅ Explicit configuration avoids the risk of surprises (e.g. missing configuration because of improper annotations or class-path scanning)
items.translation: ✅ 显式配置可避免意外情况（例如，因注解不当或类路径扫描问题导致配置缺失）。

items.source: ⚠️ An Explicit Field Configuration can diverge from the domain model and you must keep it in sync with the domain model
items.translation: ⚠️ 显式字段配置可能与领域模型不一致，您必须确保其始终与领域模型保持同步。

items.source:
Derived setup relies on annotations in your domain model and automatically generates the required encrypted field configuration from it.
This is simpler and recommended for typical Spring applications where your data model is already annotated.
items.translation:
派生配置依赖于您领域模型中的注解，并自动从中生成所需的加密字段配置。
对于数据模型已添加注解的典型 Spring 应用程序，这种方式更简单且推荐使用。

items.source: ✅ Domain model-driven configuration
items.translation: ✅ 基于领域模型的配置

items.source: ✅ Easy to set up and maintain
items.translation: ✅ 易于设置和维护

items.source: ⚠️ Might not cover all complex scenarios
items.translation: ⚠️ 可能无法涵盖所有复杂场景

items.source: ⚠️ Risk of surprises (e.g. missing configuration for documents based on subtypes because of improper annotations or class-path scanning)
items.translation: ⚠️ 存在意外风险（例如，由于标注不当或类路径扫描问题，导致基于子类型的文档缺少配置）

Those fields can be queried normally. 2 pin is encrypted but does not support queries. 3 ssn is encrypted and allows equality queries. 4 age is encrypted and allows range queries between 0 and 150. 5 height is encrypted and allows range queries between 0.3 and 2.5.

2 pin 字段已加密但不支持查询。
3 ssn 字段已加密，支持等值查询。
4 age 字段已加密，支持在 0 到 150 之间进行范围查询。
5 height 字段已加密，支持在 0.3 到 2.5 之间进行范围查询。

items.source: 1 Encrypts the value of the simple type such as a String if not null. 2 Encrypts the entire Address object and all its nested fields as Document. To only encrypt parts of the Address, like Address#street the street field within Address needs to be annotated with @ExplicitEncrypted. 3 Collection-like fields are encrypted as single value and not per entry. 4 Map-like fields are encrypted as single value and not as a key/value entry.
items.translation:
1 如果值不为 null，则加密简单类型（如 String）的值。
2 将整个 Address 对象及其所有嵌套字段作为 Document 进行加密。若要仅加密 Address 的部分字段（例如 Address#street），则需要在 Address 内部的 street 字段上添加 @ExplicitEncrypted 注解。
3 类似 Collection 的字段被加密为单个值，而非按条目分别加密。
4 类似 Map 的字段被加密为单个值，而非作为键/值对进行加密。

items.source: 1 Set up a Encryption engine using com.mongodb.client.vault.ClientEncryption. The instance is stateful and must be closed after usage. Spring takes care of this because ClientEncryption is Closeable. 2 Set up an annotation-based EncryptionKeyResolver to determine the EncryptionKey from annotations. 3 Create the MongoEncryptionConverter. 4 Enable for a PropertyValueConverter lookup from the BeanFactory.
items.translation: 1 使用 com.mongodb.client.vault.ClientEncryption 配置一个 Encryption 引擎。该实例是有状态的，使用后必须关闭。Spring 会自动处理此操作，因为 ClientEncryption 实现了 Closeable 接口。 2 配置基于注解的 EncryptionKeyResolver，以便从注解中确定 EncryptionKey。 3 创建 MongoEncryptionConverter。 4 启用从 BeanFactory 查找 PropertyValueConverter 的功能。
